Photo credits

Every snake photo on SnakeList was taken by the person named below and is used under the Creative Commons licence they chose for it. SnakeList is free, has no ads and makes no money from these photos.

To fit SnakeList, each photo is cropped and resized; nothing else about it is changed. The “original” link opens the photo as the photographer shared it (on iNaturalist, where each of these photos has its own page and licence).

Photos marked “No Derivatives” (ND) are not used, because cropping counts as changing a photo. The 174 fossil snakes are shown with SnakeList’s own illustrations, as no photo of them can exist.

If you took one of these photos and want the credit changed or the photo removed, contact SnakeList through the About creator page and it will be done.
